Module org.example.sodoku
Package com.example.sudoku.controller

Interface ISudokuController

All Known Implementing Classes:
SudokuController
public interface ISudokuController
Interface defining the contract for the Sudoku game controller. Handles cell interaction, number selection, hints, and game state.
